name: The Forge
text: A soot-black anvil and a patient smith. Strip an item's infusion, for gold.

name: A Fallen Cache
text: Someone's gear, left where they fell. An item, free to take.

name: A Rift Seep
text: Essence beads on the rocks like dew. An essence, free to take.

name: Scattered Coin
text: Coins glint in the ash. Gold, free to take.

name: A Sealed Vault
text: Spend a key on a sealed chest: a better item or a relic.

name: The Old Drill Yard
text: Straw targets and a stern old sergeant. Switch a hero to another specialization.

name: The Caravan
text: The guild's old friends, their wagon heaped with a bit of everything. Any item.

name: The Whetstone Stall
text: A grinder's wheel sings over a rack of edges. Blade items.

name: The Fletcher's Cart
text: Bundled arrows and bows strung tight. Bow items.

name: The Arcanist's Stall
text: Candle-stub tomes and humming charms. Spell items.

name: The Apothecary
text: Jars of salve and something simmering on a brazier. Mend items.

name: The Shieldwright
text: Dented bucklers, freshly riveted. Ward items.

name: The Tinderbox
text: Everything here smells of smoke. Burn items.

name: The Barber-Surgeon
text: Clean saws, dirty aprons. Bleed items.

name: The Hedge Witch
text: Bundled herbs, a black cat, and prices she won't haggle on. Hex items.

name: The Arms Rack
text: Weapons for a hero's own hand. Basic-attack items.

name: The Tinker's Bench
text: Contraptions that fire on their own. Ability items.

name: The Charm Seller
text: Trinkets on strings that hum when danger's near. Passive items.

name: The Ember-Seller
text: A brazier-cart and a woman with singed eyebrows. Ember essence, and items that burn.

name: The Venom-Seller
text: Stoppered vials, handled with gloves. Venom essence, and items that poison and wound.

name: The Wrath-Seller
text: A scarred veteran selling red, angry essence. Wrath essence, and weapons.

name: The Stone-Seller
text: Grey essence, heavy as a cairn. Stone essence, and Ward items.

name: The Verdant-Seller
text: Moss grows on the cart wheels. Verdant essence, and Mend items.

name: The Frost-Seller
text: Rime on every bottle. Frost essence, and Hex and Ward items.

name: The Storm-Seller
text: The air crackles around the stall. Storm essence, and Bow and Spell items.

name: The Umbral-Seller
text: A stall you only notice once you're at it. Umbral essence, and Bleed and Blade items.

name: A Smith's Cart
text: A travelling smith's cart, every blade already honed. Everything here is B tier.

name: The Ashen Market
text: Stalls in the ash, lit by rift-glow. Their wares are old and fine: A tier, at A-tier prices.

name: The Synergy Peddler
text: A sly old peddler who knows what goes with what, and won't say why. Items that suit what you already hold.
